# Security policy

Report suspected vulnerabilities through
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/LancePerdue23/roblox-multi-instance/security/advisories/new).

This route must be enabled by the maintainer after the repository becomes public.
If GitHub does not offer private reporting, there is currently no configured
private reporting channel. Do not post vulnerability details in a public issue;
wait until private reporting is available. No personal email address is published.

Never attach credentials, cookies, account profiles, private keys, or raw
diagnostics to a public issue.

Include affected versions/edition, Windows version, impact, and minimal steps
using synthetic data. Describe any sensitive evidence first so a private transfer
can be arranged. There is no guaranteed response time or paid bounty.

Security fixes target the latest stable release. Until a stable release exists,
reports against the latest validation prerelease are welcome. Older validation
builds are not maintained independently; fixes may require upgrading.
